tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Finds production companies by name substring (q) or company category slug. Returns name, categories, description, website and url; a company's productions are not included.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Returns one production company by slug, id, or productionlist.com/production-contact/… URL, with its description, categories, website, url, and the productions attached to it (active first). Contact details are never included.

tools.name: get_taxonomies
tools.description: Returns the valid slugs for the stage, type, status and company category filters.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_productions, get_production, search_companies, get_company · Private data: get_production, get_company · Public sink: search_productions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_productions, get_production, search_companies, get_company · Private data: get_production, get_company · Public sink: search_productions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_productions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
